description: `@items = load(@page, @items)` depends on @page only: on mount it loads 0+1, and each change of @page re-runs it once (1+2 = 3) — its own settle (a write of @items) never re-triggers it.
rationale: §6.7.7: "`<request>` is not a loop … the body executes once on mount, then only on dependency change or `refetch()`".
